name: API Connector
definition: A tool that allows users to bring data from third-party sources into Adobe Experience Platform via RESTful APIs.

name: Activation
definition: The process of making audience segments available for use in marketing channels and destinations.
categories: CJA, RT-CDP Collaboration, TLA (3 letter abbreviation)

name: Offer Decisioning
definition: A capability that delivers the best offer and experience to your customers across all touchpoints at the right time.

name: Flow Service
definition: An API service used to collect and centralize customer data from various sources within Adobe Experience Platform.

name: Legacy Launch
definition: The previous name for Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection before rebranding.

name: Visitor ID Service
definition: Legacy term for the Adobe Experience Cloud Identity Service that manages cross-solution identity.

name: DTM
definition: Dynamic Tag Management, the predecessor to Adobe Experience Platform Tags for managing analytics and marketing tags.

name: Data Workbench
definition: Legacy analytics tool that provided multi-dimensional analysis of customer data across channels.

name: Edge Configuration
definition: Settings that determine how data is processed at the edge network for real-time personalization.

name: Query Service Notebooks
definition: Interactive environment for querying and visualizing data using SQL within Adobe Experience Platform.
